In Android settings, open VPN, tap the ⚙ next to Human Override and switch on \"Always-on VPN\". Then it starts by itself after a restart. For children, also use Google Family Link so they cannot change settings.

Human Override blocks AI services in every app on this phone by answering their address lookups with \"does not exist\". It cannot block AI built into apps you allow, AI that runs fully on the phone, or apps that use their own secure DNS. Android lets the phone owner switch any VPN off in Settings.
